description: Current state of a checkout session: requires_escalation (the customer still has to open continue_url and pay), completed (paid; order id given), incomplete (trip no longer bookable: choose another) or canceled (expired after 24 h, canceled, or turned into a quote request). The price is recomputed at each call.

id.description: Checkout session id returned by create_checkout ("chk_…").

meta.description: Optional UCP request metadata: {"ucp-agent": {"profile": "https://…/.well-known/ucp"}, "idempotency-key": "<uuid>"}. Send an idempotency key to retry safely.
